domain: SEC filing-clock balance-sheet composition state (working-capital intensity as an instant LEVEL), PIT-conditioned via pit_conditioning.py; explicitly NOT the asset-expansion (Delta-assets) channel and NOT a quality-margin or valuation channel
title: Working-capital composition state of the sector filer panel: beta-neutral long low current-asset-intensity sector aggregates versus high current-asset-intensity sector aggregates

mechanism_question.question: Does the working-capital composition of the frozen sector filer panel's asset base - the point-in-time filing-clock LEVEL of current assets relative to total assets, aggregated to the sector cohort - carry incremental, after-cost cross-sectional pricing information beyond SPY/sector beta on the authorized 12-ETF cohort? That is: are sectors whose asset bases are dominated by short-cycle operating assets (receivables, inventory, prepaid and other current items) relatively overpriced versus sectors whose asset bases are long-cycle, per unit of beta?
mechanism_question.causal_economic: Composition of the asset base is a state of HOW a sector's earnings are produced, not how fast it grew. When a large share of the asset base sits in current operating assets, each dollar of reported earnings carries more accrual and estimation content: revenue recognized ahead of cash collection, inventories valued by management estimate, receivables carrying expected-loss judgment, and period-end working-capital positions that are the classic home of earnings management. The accruals literature establishes at the firm level that the working-capital/accrual component of earnings is less persistent than the cash component and is systematically overpriced by investors who anchor on earnings levels (Sloan 1996); that accrual quality is fundamentally an estimation-error problem concentrated in working-capital positions (Dechow-Dichev 2002); and that inventory-position content specifically predicts lower future returns (Thomas-Zhang 2002). The preregistered transmission reading: a sector panel whose aggregated balance sheet shows high current-asset intensity embeds a lower-quality earnings-generating technology per unit of assets, so high-WCINT sectors should underperform low-WCINT sectors on a beta-adjusted relative basis. The live alternative the test decides is the buffer/flexibility reading - a large current-asset sleeve is precautionary liquidity that earns a risk premium - which predicts the OPPOSITE sign; either outcome resolves the direction question. This is deliberately an INSTANT LEVEL channel: one PIT read of composition per decision session, no change statistic, no growth rate. It is distinct from the asset-expansion channel (Cooper-Gulen-Schill 2008 use Delta total assets - a different mechanism question assigned to a different D1 proposal) and from quality-margin or valuation channels (no profitability, no price-scaled fundamental, no equity-yield construct enters the key).
mechanism_question.after_cost_rationale: Accrual- and composition-sorted spreads documented at single-stock granularity are of order several percent per year (Sloan 1996 reports ~10% annualized accrual-sorted spreads; Thomas-Zhang report multi-percent inventory-sorted spreads). Expected cost drag at 10 bps/side with ~0.8-2.2 two-way turnover per year (fundamental composition ranks are persistent between quarterly filing waves) is roughly 20-60 bps per year, one to two orders of magnitude below the documented anomaly scale - so a premium that truly transmits to sector granularity should survive after cost, and a borderline transmission should not, which is the discriminating property wanted.
mechanism_question.forbidden_family_distinctness: Checked against PLAN_stocks_v5.md section 1 items 1-7, the full stocks_free_v5_run/forbidden_family_inventory.json, and the generic list: (1) NOT A4_XSEC_ETF_RELATIVE_MOMENTUM and NOT ordinary momentum at any lookback: the ranking key contains zero return, price, or volume information - it is a ratio of SEC filing-clock accounting aggregates; momentum is structurally impossible from this key. (2) NOT A5-SFV2-TREND-DEFENSIVE: no SMA/EMA, no time-series filter, no volatility targeting; gross exposure is a frozen constant (3x +1/6, 3x -1/6, bounded hedge) and never scales with any risk statistic. (3) NOT SFV3-A5-IDIO-SHOCK-REVERSAL: no shock event, no overshoot statistic, no countertrade conditioned on a move; a persistent cross-sectional composition tilt held 42 sessions. (4) NOT SFV3-A6-TOM-SETTLE: a fixed session-count grid with no calendar-date claim. (5) NOT SFV4-A5-H1-PARTICIPATION-SHIFT nor any inversion: no dollar-volume, no volume, no fresh-vs-stale market-data ratio anywhere in the arm. (6) NOT SFV4-A4-H1-SEMIVARIANCE-SHARE and NOT its vol-level inversion, and NOT a Section 1.1 front-door entry: the family is exploratory (no V4 control-arm ancestry claimed), and the key contains no variance of any kind - single-name, cross-sectional, or sign-partitioned. (7) NOT a rescue subset: the 9-sector eligible ranking set is dictated ex ante by the A1 coverage census (fundable = pre-S0 availability fraction >= 0.80), exactly the sanctioned coverage/availability-driven eligibility pattern (V4 XLC price-history rule); it removes XLF and XLRE because current-asset disclosure is not a fundable construct there (census 0.25 and 0.20), not because of any outcome knowledge (none exists; budget 0/6). Generic list: no OHLCV proxy of fundamentals (conditioning is SEC-only; price data enter ONLY portfolio returns and the SPY hedge, never the conditioning key); no earnings-surprise/analyst/flows/borrow/spread content; one mechanism, no indicator grid; no new data entitlements (SEC_EDGAR is the AUTHORIZED V5 source).

falsifiable_prediction: Sign: NEGATIVE cross-sectional relation between the sector panel's working-capital intensity WCINT_s(d) = mean(AssetsCurrent)/mean(Assets) at decision session d and forward beta-adjusted relative sector returns over the next 42 sessions. Operationally, the anchor (long the 3 lowest-WCINT eligible sectors, short the 3 highest, SPY-beta-neutralized, 42-session holding) must show: (i) after-cost expectancy > 0; (ii) positive incremental alpha versus its declared zero-multiple risk-matched SPY context overall and in >= 2 of 3 folds; (iii) the mirror book (long high / short low) must NOT also work; (iv) the us-gaap:Assets LEVEL (scale) control must NOT reproduce the result under its own preregistered rule. If the buffer/flexibility reading is correct, the anchor loses money and is rejected; if the scale channel explains any positive anchor result, the control fires and the family is falsified. All three resolutions are informative and none can be tuned around.
literature: Sloan, R. (1996), 'Do Stock Prices Fully Reflect Information in Accruals and Cash Flows About Future Earnings?', The Accounting Review 71(3), 289-315 - the accrual (working-capital) component of earnings is less persistent and overpriced; the level/composition channel's source result.

Dechow, P. and Dichev, I. (2002), 'The Quality of Accruals and Earnings: The Role of Accrual Estimation Errors', The Accounting Review 77(s-1), 35-59 - working-capital positions are where accrual estimation error concentrates; the estimation-risk content of the composition state.

Thomas, J. and Zhang, X. (2002), 'Inventory Changes and Future Returns', Review of Accounting Studies 7(2-3), 163-187 - the working-capital subcomponent most tied to demand-cycle and margin-compression exposure; supports the negative transmission sign.

Cooper, M., Gulen, H. and Schill, M. (2008), 'Asset Growth and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns', Journal of Finance 63(4), 1609-1651 - cited for the DECLARED DISTINCTION: that family is the expansion (Delta-assets) channel, not the composition (current/total LEVEL) channel measured here; no growth rate enters this key.

Frozen 410-filer panel (.staging_sec/panel.json; per-sector filers per the packet census: 40/40 per sector), normalized store pit_records.jsonl, store_sha256 f53eb3712bc9d686ec8a91b3715beaf73be1e5243a89af1816bd62eea51df955, 3,817,158 records. aggregation_declaration_frozen_ex_ante.field_roles: us-gaap:AssetsCurrent is the numerator, us-gaap:Assets the denominator; no third field, no substitution, no fallback field exists in this family
aggregation_declaration_frozen_ex_ante.construction: WCINT_s(d) = A_s(d) / B_s(d), where A_s(d) is the frozen single-vintage equal-weight mean (math.fsum over sorted entity order) of AssetsCurrent over the filers included at A_s's own latest gated effective date, and B_s(d) is the same construction for Assets. Each leg is independently gated and as-of selected by the frozen bridge; no cross-field vintage matching is attempted (declared now to prevent implementation drift). In the per-filer limit the ratio measures composition; the equal-weight means keep composition and scale as separate moments of the panel.
aggregation_declaration_frozen_ex_ante.max_filing_gap_days_rationale: 200 days exceeds the longest regular filing-clock inter-stamp gap (non-accelerated cadence: 10-Q within 45 days of a ~91-day quarter and 10-K within 90 days of a ~365-day year imply stamp-to-stamp gaps <= ~180 days), so every filer on a regular quarterly rhythm stays in the panel while a filer silent for more than roughly two quarters drops out by the explicit, PIT-clean filing-clock rule (survivorship-aware: coverage counts report exactly who is in). Declared ex ante at proposal level per binding_rules.aggregation_declaration; frozen at family freeze; never tuned after scored PnL.
aggregation_declaration_frozen_ex_ante.coverage_floor_rule: at each decision session a sector is eligible only if BOTH legs' SectorObservation.coverage (= filers_included / filers_mapped) >= 0.40; coverage is reported per observation by the frozen bridge
aggregation_declaration_frozen_ex_ante.tuning_pledge: field list, gap parameter and floor are fixed before any scored PnL exists anywhere in the tree; they are never revised after scored results are visible

census_fundability_of_declared_fields.eligibility_consequence: XLF and XLRE are structurally excluded ex ante by the census (AssetsCurrent not fundable there); the eligible ranking set is the 9 sectors where BOTH fields are fundable (fraction >= 0.80). This is a coverage-driven eligibility rule fixed before any scoring, not a results-driven subset choice.

pit_observable_with_availability_semanti.availability_semantics: SEC filed dates are date-only: availability is the end of the filed UTC day (23:59:59Z, conservative upper bound); retrieval time never substitutes. Conditioning-lag rule (+1 session after availability) is enforced by construction through pit_conditioning.session_gate_utc: a decision taken at session d reads only records with available_time_utc < 00:00 UTC of d, so a stamp landing inside session d (or on a non-session day) first influences the next session. Regression-pinned in tests/assets/stocks/test_pit_conditioning_adoption.py. Sanitizer handling (conflicting-duplicate facts drop both values) is constant across all arms per the packet census.

universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.universe: the frozen 12-ETF cohort (cohort digest 02c0fa979cec2b214a99af07f05108546fa523dee31ea5fb6b1049c06f21b6e1; snapshot manifest 62ac324d7e683961b0d88f85153e4a072d09fe0a6745a54687b9e3b219d8f658, 37 files). Ranked set = census-fundable 9 sectors {XLB, XLC, XLE, XLI, XLK, XLP, XLU, XLV, XLY} intersected with the fixed ETF price-history rule (>= 252 sessions of adjusted history through d, required by the beta hedge): the early-S0 ranked set is {XLB, XLE, XLI, XLK, XLP, XLU, XLY} (7 sectors) and XLC joins at ~2019-06 giving 9 - a fixed availability rule declared ex ante. XLF and XLRE are never ranked (census). SPY is hedge instrument and benchmark context only, never ranked.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.warmup_sessions: 252 for the beta window, drawn from the 2076-session pre-S0 runway (first decision's betas estimated on adjusted close-to-close sessions 2017-04-05..2018-04-04). The conditioning panel itself needs 0 warmup sessions: the PIT as-of bridge supplies latest gated vintages at the first S0 session, and the census (pre-S0 availability fraction >= 0.80 per eligible sector and field) guarantees usable aggregates exist on day one.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.decision_clock: at the close (PIT) of every 42nd SPY-calendar session within S0 (2018-04-04..2025-07-31, 1842 sessions), first decision at 2018-04-04; only information through that close is used
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.holding_period: 42 sessions per decision; weights held unchanged between decisions; book forced flat at every fold boundary per baseline invariants (a decision shortly before a boundary holds a truncated stub)
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.fill_clock: next allowed session after the decision close, open-adjacent close-to-close execution per baseline invariants ADJ-1-EXEC-CLOCK; no same-session fill

anchor.name: WCINT42-BN-L3S3
anchor.rule: At each decision session d: (1) form the eligible sector set: census-fundable 9, both legs' coverage >= 0.40 at d, and >= 252 sessions of adjusted ETF history through d; (2) compute WCINT_s(d) = A_s(d)/B_s(d) from the two frozen bridge aggregates (fields, gap 200, floor 0.40 exactly as declared); (3) rank eligible sectors ASCENDING by WCINT; (4) long the 3 lowest at +1/6 weight each, short the 3 highest at -1/6 weight each; (5) estimate beta_s(d) by OLS of sector s adjusted close-to-close daily returns on SPY adjusted close-to-close daily returns over the last 252 sessions through d and set the hedge leg w_SPY(d) = -sum_s(w_s * beta_s), truncated to [-0.25, +0.25]; (6) residual weight to CASH; frozen gross cap 1.25; long/short books accounted separately per baseline invariants. Frozen skip rule: if fewer than 6 sectors are eligible at d the decision is skipped and not scored (census arithmetic makes this measure-zero in expectation - 7 sectors are eligible from S0 start - and A9-F verifies the scored schedule on the real panel and calendar). No other rule exists.
anchor.exactness: single ratio (two declared fields), single gap parameter (200), single coverage floor (0.40), single grid (42), single basket size (3+3), single weight (1/6), single beta window (252), single truncation ([-0.25,+0.25]) - no parameter menu, no grid, no best-of

neighbour.name: WCINT21-BN-L3S3
neighbour.rule: Identical to the anchor in every fixed choice except the decision grid: the same composition state is read every 21st session instead of every 42nd (same fields, same gap, same floor, same baskets, same hedge, same weights). If the composition mechanism is real, reading the same state twice as often must show the same sign with lower per-decision noise; disagreement between the two grids refutes the state interpretation.
neighbour.role: mechanism support required by stage-A gates (neighbour_mechanism_support); ~88 decision periods, satisfying the per-arm floors

causal_negative_control.name: ASSET-LVL42-BN-L3S3 (panel-scale control)
causal_negative_control.rule: Identical surface form: same 42-session grid, same eligible-set rules, same 3+3 baskets at +/-1/6, same 252-session beta hedge, same gross cap and accounting - but the ranking key is the frozen bridge aggregate of us-gaap:Assets LEVEL alone (long the 3 sectors with the smallest panel-mean asset base, short the 3 largest). The numerator is discarded entirely: no composition content survives.
causal_negative_control.must_not_carry_mechanism_if_story_true: If the composition/accrual-quality story is true, a book whose composition is determined by absolute panel asset scale carries no composition premium; its expectancy is statistically zero. The control CAN fire - a size/scale channel (large-asset-base panels = capital-intensive and regulated sectors versus asset-light panels) is a genuine competing mechanism - and if it fires, the anchor result is attributable to scale exposure, not composition.
causal_negative_control.preregistered_falsification_rule: The anchor is REJECTED if the control's incremental alpha satisfies |alpha_control| >= 0.5 * |alpha_anchor| (control_alpha_abs_ratio gate, baseline invariants), or if control expectancy > 0 with per-position PF >= 1.0. Either outcome means the scale form, not the working-capital composition ranking, generated the anchor result; the mechanism class is falsified for this universe and no rescue variant may be proposed.

control_identifiability_without_pnl.lesson: L7: a control rank-identical (or near-identical, |rho| 0.78-0.83 in V4) to its anchor cannot identify anything; collinearity must be measured BEFORE selection
control_identifiability_without_pnl.a9f_recipe_no_pnl: Both conditioning panels are pure feature objects computable from the frozen SEC store with zero PnL: A9-F runs pit_conditioning.conditioning_panel for us-gaap:AssetsCurrent, us-gaap:Assets and us-gaap:Assets over the S0 decision grid, forms the WCINT rank vector and the Assets-LEVEL rank vector per session, and measures (a) Spearman rho(WCINT ranks, ASSET-LVL ranks) per decision session and its mean, (b) basket leg-overlap (shared sectors between long legs plus between short legs), (c) side-sign disagreement count.
control_identifiability_without_pnl.preselection_kill_thresholds: family dies before selection if mean |rho| >= 0.60 across decision sessions, or if >= 2 of 3 legs share the same side in >= 70% of sessions - the V4 pre-selection discipline applied verbatim
control_identifiability_without_pnl.by_construction_argument: The anchor key's cross-sectional variation is the panel's degree of current-asset intensity (a bounded composition statistic); the control key is the panel's absolute asset scale. No accounting identity ties a composition ratio's ordering to a scale ordering: composition is invariant to uniform per-filer rescaling in the limit the aggregation approximates, while scale is nothing but that rescaling; and among GICS sector groups, capital-intensity composition and balance-sheet size cut across each other (asset-light panels can be large-mean and small-mean, and long-cycle regulated panels likewise), so the orderings are not forced to any sign. The measured gate, not the prose, is decisive - and the measurement exists exactly because it needs no PnL.

incremental_alpha_test.primary: incremental alpha per the frozen benchmark contract: incremental_alpha(arm, window) = R_arm(window) - R_spy_context(window), evaluated per fold AND overall on S0; the arm's frozen ex-ante risk-match declaration is a ZERO SPY-context multiple, because the construction zeroes net SPY beta by rule via the hedge leg (declared before any return is computed; realized arm volatility or realized beta is never substituted post hoc); a pass requires positive incremental alpha overall and in >= 2 of 3 folds per stage-A gates
incremental_alpha_test.sector_neutralization: the optional equal-weight sector factor (EW_SECTOR_TOTAL_RETURN per the benchmark contract) is reported as a secondary residual diagnostic: regress arm daily returns on [SPY context, EW-sector context]; the residual mean must be positive per fold. Caveat declared ex ante: the legs ARE members of the EW-sector factor, so the SPY risk-match is the primary identifying test and the EW-sector residual is diagnostic only
incremental_alpha_test.fail_closed: raw PnL, long-equity beta, or sector beta is never accepted as alpha (V2/V3/V4 lesson; L6); the control gate and the incremental-alpha gate both bind regardless of raw PnL

base_and_stress_costs.costs: 10 bps per side per fill (base), 20 bps per side per fill (stress rerun), charged exactly once per fill per P1-A2 invariant; benchmark paths uncosted per contract
base_and_stress_costs.cost_drag: ~20-60 bps/year at base and ~40-120 bps/year at stress at the expected turnover below; the documented accrual/composition spread scale (multi-percent) dominates this only if the channel truly transmits to sector-ETF granularity, which is exactly what the test decides

turnover_and_sample_floor.expected_turnover: the composition aggregate refreshes only as filers file (quarterly waves on staggered fiscal calendars), so WCINT ranks are highly persistent between decisions: expected basket churn ~0-1 of 6 legs per rebalance plus hedge-leg drift, i.e. expected |delta_weight| per rebalance ~0.3-0.6, giving ~0.8-2.2 two-way turnover per year annualized
turnover_and_sample_floor.why_inside_ceiling: expected 0.8-2.2 two-way/year sits well below the 6.0 ADJ-5 ceiling; the theoretical worst case (ranks whipsawing at every rebalance, ~12-13 two-way/year) would itself evidence that composition ranks carry no stable information and would fail the turnover gate by design - accepted as part of the falsification structure rather than loosening the schedule
turnover_and_sample_floor.decisions_per_fold: ~14-15 scored decisions per fold (1842 S0 sessions / 42-session grid, truncated at fold boundaries); >= 5 floor satisfied
turnover_and_sample_floor.decisions_total: ~43-44 scored decision periods overall; >= 30 floor satisfied; A9-F verifies the scored schedule arithmetic on the real calendar and the real conditioning panel (including the < 6 eligible skip rule and the 0.40 coverage floor) before selection
turnover_and_sample_floor.positions_per_decision: 6 sector legs + 1 SPY hedge leg + CASH residual; >= 1 non-CASH leg invariant always satisfied

drop_one_design.expected_concentration: no single leg exceeds 1/6 (~16.7%) of gross, under the 0.35 per-symbol positive-share gate; the book is an order statistic over a persistent panel aggregate, so any single sector's expectancy contribution is expected well under 25%; a residual risk is one filing epoch (e.g. an energy or retail inventory shock) moving several panels at once - the drop-one-fold gate detects that
drop_one_design.drop_one_etf: rerun the full value book excluding the max-contribution symbol; survival = after-drop expectancy > 0. With 7 eligible sectors early-S0 the drop leaves exactly 6, so the frozen 3+3 baskets still form and the skip rule never triggers post-drop; the premium must be a property of the cross-sectional composition ordering, not of one sector's filing pattern
drop_one_design.drop_one_fold: min over folds of expectancy with that fold removed; survival = min > 0; the three folds span structurally different regimes (2018-2020 Volmageddon and COVID, 2020-2023 inflation/rate shock, 2023-2025 AI-concentration rally), and filing waves recur in all three, so a genuine composition premium must not depend on a single regime

failure_interpretation: A reject means the working-capital composition channel documented at single-stock level does not transmit to beta-neutral cross-sectional pricing of sector filer panels at a 42-session horizon after 10-20 bps costs - the accrual-quality story is either absent at sector granularity or the buffer/flexibility reading wins with the opposite sign (in which case the preregistered anchor loses and the direction question is answered negatively). If the ASSET-LVL control fires while the anchor works, the sharper conclusion is that any premium in this skeleton is sector scale exposure, not composition - the family is falsified and A7-N must treat field-swap or threshold-jiggle descendants of this skeleton as descendants of a rejected family. A negative result here closes the working-capital LEVEL direction only; it makes no claim about the separate expansion (Delta-assets) family.
source_to_test_map: 1. Sloan (1996): the accrual/working-capital component of earnings is overpriced -> implement the composition LEVEL WCINT = mean(AssetsCurrent)/mean(Assets) from the frozen bridge (anchor steps 1-2) and preregister the negative-transmission sign with long-low/short-high 3+3 baskets (anchor steps 3-4).

2. Dechow-Dichev (2002) and Thomas-Zhang (2002): estimation risk concentrates in working-capital positions -> the key is the instant level of the current-asset sleeve, PIT-gated with no change statistic; the +1-session conditioning lag is enforced by session_gate_utc and regression-pinned.

3. Filing-clock survivorship handling -> max_filing_gap_days = 200 declared ex ante with the 0.40 per-leg coverage floor; filers that stop filing drop out by the explicit clock, coverage counts reported per observation.

4. Cooper-Gulen-Schill (2008) marks the boundary: the expansion channel is Delta-assets and is NOT this family -> the control sorts on us-gaap:Assets LEVEL, which must NOT reproduce the anchor (|alpha ratio| < 0.5 gate), simultaneously probing the scale-exposure artifact.

5. Composition vs scale orderings must be identifiable BEFORE selection -> A9-F measures Spearman rho and basket overlap between the WCINT and ASSET-LVL panels (pure feature computation, no PnL) against the declared 0.60 / 2-of-3-leg kill thresholds (L7).

6. The claim must be market-direction-free and survive costs -> 252-session OLS SPY hedge with declared zero SPY-context risk-match (incremental_alpha_test) and frozen 10/20 bps costs on ~0.8-2.2 two-way/year (base_and_stress_costs, turnover_and_sample_floor).
